title: U+FE0F hygiene — do not strip it
resolution: the selector survives in exactly one file, `lib/print_message.sh`, on three characters: `ℹ️` (U+2139), `⏭️` (U+23ED) and `⚠️` (U+26A0). Those three have a text presentation by default, so removing VS16 turns the run's prefixes into monochrome glyphs — it degrades the output rather than cleaning it. If a variation-selector CI scan is ever added, allowlist these three; that is the correct fix here.
